text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the 'Japanese Derby'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"According to Neo Universe's 'future 
prediction,' the weather will be rain. 
However—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is... far beyond mere rain. An 
unseasonal typhoon. And—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carelessly, I ended up getting held up at 
the station roundabout...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I went back to get the important 
documents... the heavy rain and strong 
winds completely paralyzed public transit. 
At this rate...
choice_data_list: I'm not gonna make it to the race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not being able to be there for my 
trainee's Derby... Nothing feels more 
pathetic than this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a huge line for taxis, too. If 
it's come to this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stepped out toward the road beside me 
and waved desperately. Even if I have to 
hitchhike, I must get back to the 
racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Even so—come. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Because "I want to run." For your sake. 
And... together with "you."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I had to respond to Neo Universe's 
feelings, no matter what it took."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drenched by the water splashed up by 
passing cars, I desperately kept raising 
my hand. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Skreee!)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, over here!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A ride! You should hop in my car! It'll be 
comfy all the way to Fuchu!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected lifeline from Chairwoman 
Akikawa saved the day. Still... something 
feels decidedly strange...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unexpected typhoon, unforeseen support. 
Such an overwhelming—chain of 
coincidences. And all of it—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Shutting out our bond... The bulkhead... 
of the contract.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this somehow be connected to those 
words Neo Universe spoke?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's almost as if—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... We made it in time, didn't we.
choice_data_list: Yeah, sorry for keeping you waiting!
Yeah, sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurried through preparations and headed 
for the paddock. Yes, waiting there was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Someone is waiting for Neo Universe. One 
who has finally sprinted onto this stage—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Uni-san! Thank goodness...! Trainer made 
it in time, didn't they!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to today! It took me 
quite a while to finally get to run in a 
GⅠ alongside you, Uni-san.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Zenno... Rob Roy...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
While you were waiting for me... weren't 
you cold? The typhoon...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, yes... I'd be lying if I said it 
wasn't cold, though...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Still, I'll be just fine. Because I'm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because I'm a hero in the making!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: An embryonic... hero...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, having left the library, I've finally 
reached the high peak. The cliffs are 
steep and the winds are sharp, but—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"You cannot whittle away this courage! Not 
the courage of one who strives to be a 
hero!"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I see... Thank goodness... Zenno Rob Roy 
truly is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You're "holding back," aren't you? First, 
I want to "connect" with you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to sparring with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As race time approached... the storm 
finally settled, and the rain began to 
stop. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The turf is still rough. Can the two 
overcome this muddy mess and reach an 
understanding?
